selection_decision: Selected after the observed development pilot and the declared proxy-class-count feasibility audit; both passing candidates are retained, with no model-performance selection. This complementary DEVELOPMENT test covers 1062 outside-giant files,16.12 percent of the historical DAppSCAN population; the giant82.10 percent is excluded from test. Restrictions use the original capped7080-object observed graph only. Expanded uncapped/external graph validity is pending and must be reported as a separate sensitivity; this is not proof of source-wide family independence and not an external confirmation. Separate bundle files and five sampling seeds do not imply independent studies. No external scoring is authorised.
limitations: Post-pilot development design, not untouched confirmation
Outside-giant designs represent a changed test population
Operational screens are not power calculations
Repeated tests overlap and are not independent studies
